mcq.q: What does the woman's search teach us about money?
options: Money is valuable and should be looked after

mcq.q: Where is the parable of the mustard seed found in Luke?
What is the mustard seed like in size?
mcq.explanation: It is one of the smallest seeds.

mcq.q: What does the seed grow into?
mcq.explanation: The seed grew and became a tree.

mcq.q: What rests in the branches of the tree?
mcq.explanation: The birds perched in its branches.

mcq.q: What does the mustard seed stand for?
options: The small beginning of God's kingdom

mcq.q: What does the big tree stand for?
What does the kingdom of God mean?
options: God's rule in the hearts of people who obey Him

mcq.q: What does "evangelise" mean?
options: To tell others the good news about Jesus

mcq.q: How many people were baptised on the day of Pentecost?
Which of these helps God's kingdom grow?
options: A good example and sharing the good news
mcq.explanation: We help by our life and words.

mcq.q: What does a seed need to grow?
mcq.explanation: Seeds need soil, water and light.

mcq.q: Which value do we learn when we plant and water a seed?
mcq.explanation: Caring for a plant teaches responsibility.

mcq.q: What does planting trees do for God's creation?
mcq.explanation: Trees give shade, fruit and homes for birds.

mcq.q: Who visited Jesus at night?
mcq.explanation: John 3:1-2 says Nicodemus came at night.

mcq.q: What group did Nicodemus belong to?
What did Jesus say a person must be to see the kingdom of God?
What question did Nicodemus ask about being born again?
options: How can someone be born when old?
mcq.explanation: He was puzzled about a second birth.

mcq.q: What did Jesus say a person must be born of?
Which verse says that God so loved the world?
What is eternal life?
options: Life with God that never ends
mcq.explanation: Eternal life is everlasting life with God.

mcq.q: What is baptism?
options: A Christian act of washing with water in the name of Father, Son and Holy Spirit
mcq.explanation: Baptism is a sign of new life.

mcq.q: Who baptised Jesus?
What did Nicodemus bring to prepare Jesus' body for burial?
mcq.explanation: John 19:39 says he brought myrrh and aloes.

mcq.q: What does repentance do?
options: It pushes us away from God
It draws us close to Christ
mcq.explanation: Repenting means turning to God for a new start.

mcq.q: What did Nicodemus say to defend Jesus in John 7:50-51?
options: Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him?
mcq.explanation: Nicodemus asked for a fair hearing.

mcq.q: Which of these shows a good response to John 3:16?
options: Believing in Jesus and thanking God
mcq.explanation: We respond with faith and thanks.

mcq.q: What does it mean to trust someone?
options: To believe they are honest and will not harm you
mcq.explanation: Trust means believing someone is reliable.

mcq.q: Which verse says that those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion?
Who was tempted by Potiphar's wife?
mcq.explanation: Genesis 39 tells the story of Joseph.

mcq.q: What did Joseph do when he was tempted?
mcq.explanation: He left his cloak and ran out of the house.

mcq.q: What did Joseph say about doing the wrong thing?
options: How could I sin against God?

mcq.q: What does being assertive mean?
options: Saying no to wrong firmly and politely
mcq.explanation: Assertive means standing for what is right.

mcq.q: Who is a stranger?
mcq.explanation: A stranger is someone you do not know.

mcq.q: A stranger offers you a lift. What should you do?
options: Say no and tell a trusted adult

mcq.q: Which of these is a trusted person at school?
If a stranger tries to grab you, what should you do?
options: Shout for help and run to a safe place

mcq.q: Which helpline can children in Kenya call for help?
Why should we trust God always?
Which of these is a sign of an unsafe secret?
options: It makes you feel scared or uncomfortable
It is about a surprise gift
mcq.explanation: Bad secrets should be told to trusted adults.

mcq.q: What is a lie?
options: A false statement told to deceive
mcq.explanation: A lie is not true and is told to deceive.

mcq.q: Which verse tells us to speak truthfully to our neighbour?
mcq.explanation: Ephesians 4:25 says to put off falsehood.

mcq.q: Which verse says that truthful lips endure for ever?
Which commandment forbids false testimony?
What does integrity mean?
options: Doing right when nobody is watching

mcq.q: Which of these is dishonest?
What is one result of lying?
What should you do if you broke a cup?
options: Tell the truth and say sorry

mcq.q: What does exaggeration mean?
options: Making things sound bigger than they are

mcq.q: Which story is a fable about lying but is not in the Bible?
options: The shepherd boy and the wolf
mcq.explanation: The boy who cried wolf is a fable.

mcq.q: How should we tell the truth?
Which of these helps us to overcome lying?
Why does a truthful person feel peaceful?
Which commandment says "Honour your father and your mother"?
What does obedience mean?
options: Doing what those in authority say when it is good and right

mcq.q: Which verse tells children to obey parents in the Lord?
Who was obedient to his parents at Nazareth?
Who ate the fruit God had forbidden?
mcq.explanation: Genesis 3 tells about Adam and Eve.

mcq.q: Who tried to run away from God's task?
mcq.explanation: Jonah ran away before he obeyed.

mcq.q: Which is a school rule?
mcq.explanation: Being on time is a common school rule.

mcq.q: Why should we obey teachers?
options: They guide us and help us learn
mcq.explanation: Teachers care for our progress and safety.

mcq.q: Which is a result of disobedience?
Which is a benefit of obeying parents?
What should you do if an adult tells you to do something that hurts you?
options: Refuse and tell a trusted adult

short.q: Give four things that help our faith to grow.
short.answer: Prayer, Bible reading, worship with others, obedience, good friends.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid thing up to 4.

short.q: Explain how the early church shows that God's kingdom grew from a small beginning.
short.answer: Jesus began with a few disciples. On Pentecost about three thousand believed and were baptised. The church spread to many towns and countries, and today it is found in all the world including Kenya.
short.working: 1 mark for the few disciples, 1 for Pentecost, 1 for three thousand, 1 for spreading, 1 for today's church.

short.q: Who was Nicodemus?
short.answer: A Pharisee and a member of the Jewish ruling council who visited Jesus at night.
short.working: 1 mark for Pharisee or leader and 1 for visiting Jesus.

short.q: Explain what "born again" means.
short.answer: A new spiritual birth, a fresh start given by God through the Holy Spirit.
short.working: 1 mark for new life and 1 for the Holy Spirit.

short.q: Give three reasons why baptism is important to Christians.
short.answer: It shows a decision to follow Jesus; it is a sign of being washed from sin; it joins us to the church; Jesus taught it.

short.q: State three things that show that Nicodemus changed.
short.answer: He defended Jesus fairly; he brought spices for Jesus' burial; he showed courage.

short.q: Write John 3:16 in your own words and explain what it teaches.
short.answer: God loved the world so much that He gave His only Son so that everyone who believes in Him will not be lost but will have eternal life. It teaches God's love and the way to eternal life.
short.working: 1 mark for God's love, 1 for giving Jesus, 1 for believing, 1 for eternal life.

short.q: Explain how repentance draws a person close to Christ and how a child can repent.
short.answer: Sin separates us from God. When we are sorry and turn from wrong, God forgives and we draw near to Him. A child can admit wrong, say sorry to God and others, put things right, and decide to do better with the Spirit's help.
short.working: 1 mark for sin separating, 1 for forgiveness, 1 for admitting, 1 for putting right, 1 for deciding to do better.

short.q: Name two people you can trust at home or school.
short.answer: Parent, guardian, teacher, counsellor, grandparent.

short.q: State two lessons from Joseph's response to temptation.
short.answer: Say no clearly, run away, remember that sin is against God, stay faithful.

short.q: Describe three steps for saying no to temptation.
short.answer: Say no clearly, give a short reason, walk away, tell a trusted adult.

short.q: Give three rules for staying safe from strangers.
short.answer: Do not go with them, do not accept gifts or lifts, do not give personal details, shout for help, tell a trusted adult.

short.q: Explain what it means to be assertive and give an example.
short.answer: Being assertive means standing for what is right calmly and firmly. Example: refusing to copy in a test and politely saying, "No, that is cheating."
short.working: 1 mark for meaning, 1 for calm and firm, 1 for example, 1 for clear explanation.

short.q: Explain why trusting God is important and how a child shows that they trust Him.
short.answer: God made us, loves us and is faithful. He hears prayers and has helped people in the Bible. A child shows trust by praying every day, reading the Bible, obeying His teaching, and thanking Him for help.
short.working: 1 mark for God's love, 1 for faithfulness, 1 for prayer, 1 for Bible or obedience, 1 for thanks.

short.q: State two reasons why we should tell the truth.
short.answer: God commands it; people trust us; we feel peaceful; friendships stay strong.

short.q: Give two forms of dishonesty other than lying.
short.answer: Cheating, blaming others, exaggerating, gossiping, breaking promises.

short.q: State three results of telling lies.
short.answer: Loss of trust, punishment, guilt, broken friendships.

short.q: Explain what Proverbs 12:19 means.
short.answer: Truth lasts and is trusted, but lies are soon found out and do not last.
short.working: 1 mark for truth lasting, 1 for lies not lasting, 1 for clear explanation.

short.q: Describe how the story of the shepherd boy and the wolf shows the results of lying.
short.answer: The boy lied twice that a wolf was coming. Villagers came and found nothing. When a real wolf came, nobody believed him. Lies destroy trust.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

short.q: Explain how Ephesians 4:25 can be applied by a child in the classroom.
short.answer: Put off falsehood and speak truthfully because we are all members of one body. A child should not cheat, should admit mistakes, should not blame others, and should tell the teacher what really happened.
short.working: 1 mark for the verse meaning, 1 for not cheating, 1 for admitting mistakes, 1 for not blaming, 1 for telling the truth kindly.

short.q: State two benefits of obeying parents.
short.answer: Pleases God, peace at home, trust from parents, learning good habits.

short.q: Give two examples from the Bible of people who disobeyed God.
short.answer: Adam and Eve, Jonah.

short.q: List three school rules and give a reason for each.
short.answer: Arrive on time, so lessons are not disturbed; keep quiet in class, so all can learn; do not fight, so all are safe.
short.working: 1 mark for each rule with a reason.

short.q: Outline three results of disobedience.
short.answer: Punishment, danger, loss of trust, guilt, poor marks.

short.q: Explain how a child can show honour to parents in four ways.
short.answer: Greet politely, obey cheerfully, help with chores, speak kindly, say thank you, pray for them.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid way up to 4.

short.q: Explain why obedience is important at home and at school, and when a child should not obey.
short.answer: Obedience brings peace at home, safety and learning at school. It pleases God. A child should not obey instructions that are unsafe or hurt them or others. In that case they should say no and tell a trusted adult.
short.working: 1 mark for home peace, 1 for school learning, 1 for pleasing God, 1 for not obeying harmful instructions, 1 for telling a trusted adult.

short.q: Give two ways of showing love at home.
short.answer: Obey parents, help with chores, be kind to siblings, care for younger children.

short.q: State two things that the story of Jesus blessing children teaches.
short.answer: Jesus loves children; children are important; they are welcome in God's kingdom.

short.q: Explain three ways in which children can show God's love to others.
short.answer: Share, help the sick, forgive, speak kindly, include others.
